title: EcoCompute MLCube: a reproducible energy-measurement container for quantized LLM inference
description:
EcoCompute MLCube is a reproducible, containerized measurement harness for the energy cost of quantized large language model (LLM) inference. Given a model and a GPU, it measures decode-phase energy per token from direct power telemetry — NVIDIA NVML on GeForce/RTX cards — and emits a schema-validated energy report (energy per token, average power, trapezoid-integrated energy, thermal block, full stack versions). Run it in three commands on your own hardware and see where your measurement falls on the quantization energy crossover curve.

The container is the reference implementation of the EcoCompute Protocol (see Related identifiers) and the measurement tool behind the EcoCompute benchmark datasets. It is deliberately honest about coverage: AMD GPUs are detected by name and reported as unavailable for energy rather than fitted with NVIDIA-derived curves. Release schema-1.3-r5 adds a mock-tested ROCm power/temperature telemetry sampler (rocm-smi --showpower/--showtemp, lenient 5.x/6.x JSON parsing, explicit unit tests), not yet wired into the measurement flow pending real-hardware validation.

Contributions: @amarjithkumar2007-wq (AMD GPU detection #20, context_length in the measurement path #22, ROCm telemetry sampler #31); first independent replication by @gkgoing (#15, TinyLlama-1.1B NF4 on RTX 3050 Ti Laptop). Licensed Apache-2.0.
